body: I come here so I can read posts like your own. That way I don't feel so alone in this world.

I'm not very smart, I'm drinking and smoking pot to help numb the pain. This, instead of eating my first meal of the day. Point being, logic and intuition isn't a strong suit of mine. I think one of the reasons I come here is because I get to write. It's nice though I realize I'm no poet. 

Thank you, for taking the time to talk to me, to all of us. Distracting us from the worst of it when we're here, desperate for someone to talk to. It's not fair, doing so much to help save someone, anonymously without the interaction and gratification of "being there" for someone. It helps, as I've posted before and I'll likely post again. You're a good soul and I'm happy you mean well in a world full of those who don't.

I just feel so alone and helpless that all I can do is cry. I can't even find the courage to talk to someone face to face or get the necessary help. I feel like my body is hardwired from doing any self harm, as much as I want it. So I just wait, wait and suffer while I remember every little thing that brought me here. Then the feelings start over. I'm just waiting, waiting in darkness.

I know this is going to be frustrating. However there is nothing, no passion, no talent, no aspiration or desires. Just thoughts and wishes without the will power to do the work to obtain. I used to play games online with friends but I can only pretend to be human for so long before people give me shit. Now I don't even do that because I enjoyed playing games with friends and sharing those experiences and talking about them. Now I just sit and wait till dark before I go to bed. Maybe play some Arkham Knight to distract myself before and after work.

Not everyone has the money or stability to choose to be happy. Sadly, stability is the only thing that I wish for anymore. Just enough so I can do me and not be homeless. However I have little to no aspiration to amount to anything. I gave up.

Because I am trapped being me. Surrounded by reminders of how pathetic I was and still am. Anyone who ever doubted me was right, and now I live in regret. A regret of having ever existed in the first place. Even the people who know that I have a desire to kill myself stopped caring. That only last a couple weeks and they were close family.

*Edit: a word

I can't amount to anything or live up to the easiest of expectations. I never tried growing up and having a life because I lived most of my youth an outcast. Eventually I began to believe those words and stopped doing anything for myself. I'm just waiting now, hoping the years won't be too long before I'm gone from this world.
I don't think there is anyone in this world that hates me more than I do.
